_README: Copy to pricing.json and put YOUR numbers in. Only used when CREA_PRICING_MODE=calculator. The assistant quotes an estimate from these rules; you still confirm the final quote. Delete any line you don't use.
disclaimer: This is an estimate from the property details given — Connell confirms the final quote.
_size: Use EITHER per_sqm (a flat rate per m² of floor area) OR size_tiers (a flat add-on per band). Not both.
_feature_addons: matched against the free-text 'features' the assistant collected (deck, granny flat, tennis court, acreage, water views, studio...)
_service_addons: matched against the service the customer asked for
